record.field: # NOTE: no paid_amount on the OCA engine; contract.wage is the full monthly wage. # Partial-month + absence proration: for a mid-month hire/leaver the worked hours # (WORK100, clamped by the engine to the contract start/end) are fewer than the # full scheduled hours of the period; and any absence leave (dovolenka / PN / # OČR / neplatené / prekážka) cuts additional hours. Holiday and paid obstacle # are added back as náhrada at priemerný zárobok by their own rules, so reducing # BASIC here for them is correct (the wage for those hours is paid via the # náhrada, not the basic salary). Family care / unpaid leave are simply unpaid. # For a full worked month (no absence) worked == scheduled, so the result is # exactly contract.wage and the standard payslip is unchanged. # # PRORATE BY HOURS, NOT DAYS. Every náhrada pays hours × priemerný hodinový # zárobok, so cutting BASIC by a DAY fraction only makes GROSS whole when every # working day is the same length. On a 40-hour week that is not 8+8+8+8+8 — a # short Friday, say — the two disagree: one absent 10-hour day used to cut # 1/19.5 of the wage while the náhrada paid 10 hours, leaving GROSS 11.08 EUR # ABOVE the full wage for a 100 % reason that must leave it untouched. The # Enterprise engine has always prorated its paid_amount by hours, so this also # closes an 11 EUR gap between the two engines on the same input. if contract.l10n_sk_hourly_wage: # Hourly worker (e.g. DoBPŠ student, paid per actual hour): BASIC = the real # worked hours (WORK100) × the hourly rate. No proration. _h = worked_days.WORK100.number_of_hours if 'WORK100' in worked_days.dict else 0.0 result = round(_h * contract.l10n_sk_hourly_wage, 2) else: result = contract.wage if 'WORK100' in worked_days.dict: scheduled = payslip.l10n_sk_scheduled_hours() worked = worked_days.WORK100.number_of_hours # OCA models absence leaves as NEGATIVE worked-day lines (leaves_positive # unset), so take the absolute value of the hour count. The code list # lives in ONE place, models/hr_payslip.py, so the rule body and the # Python side cannot drift apart. absence = 0.0 for _code in payslip.l10n_sk_absence_codes(): if _code in worked_days.dict: absence += abs(worked_days.dict[_code].number_of_hours) paid_worked = worked - absence if scheduled and paid_worked < scheduled: result = contract.wage * paid_worked / scheduled
hours = abs(worked_days.dict['DOVOLENKA'].number_of_hours) if 'DOVOLENKA' in worked_days.dict else 0.0 result = round(hours * payslip.l10n_sk_average_hourly_earnings(), 2)
hours = abs(worked_days.dict['OBSTACLE'].number_of_hours) if 'OBSTACLE' in worked_days.dict else 0.0 result = round(hours * payslip.l10n_sk_average_hourly_earnings(), 2)

_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_sickness_ee') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = -(int(round((min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max'))) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

base = min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max')) if contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type != 'none' and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_oop: base = max(0.0, base - payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_dohoda_oop')) _r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_pension_ee') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = -(int(round((base) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

base = min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max')) if contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type != 'none' and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_oop: base = max(0.0, base - payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_dohoda_oop')) _r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_disability_ee') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = -(int(round((base) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_unemployment_ee') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = -(int(round((min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max'))) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_sickness_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max'))) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

base = min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max')) if contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type != 'none' and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_oop: base = max(0.0, base - payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_dohoda_oop')) _r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_pension_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((base) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

base = min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max')) if contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type != 'none' and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_oop: base = max(0.0, base - payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_dohoda_oop')) _r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_disability_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((base) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_unemployment_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max'))) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100
Insurance to Finance Support during Short-Time Work (Employer)

_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_shorttime_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max'))) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_guarantee_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max'))) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100 # ≥50% statutory owner is not guarantee-insured (§102 z. 461/2003). if contract.l10n_sk_guarantee_exempt: result = 0.0
_r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_accident_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((categories.GROSS) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

base = min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max')) if contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type != 'none' and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_oop: base = max(0.0, base - payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_dohoda_oop')) _r = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_social_reserve_er') # §138 z.461/2003: floor each premium DOWN to the eurocent. result = (int(round((base) * _r, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100

if contract.l10n_sk_ztp: rate = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee_ztp') else: rate = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee') base = categories.GROSS # Health OOP (odvodová odpočítateľná položka): reduces ONLY the employee health # assessment base, for a regular employment relationship (not a dohoda), when # claimed. OOP = max(0, max - slope*(gross - max)) with slope = max/(end-max) # (380/190 = 2), so base = max(0, gross - OOP). The employer base is untouched. if contract.l10n_sk_health_oop_claim and contract.l10n_sk_agreement_type == 'none': oop_max = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_oop_max') oop_end = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_oop_phaseout_end') slope = oop_max / (oop_end - oop_max) oop = max(0.0, oop_max - slope * max(0.0, base - oop_max)) base = max(0.0, base - oop) # §19 z.580/2004: floor the health preddavok DOWN to the eurocent. result = -(int(round(base * rate, 4)) / 100.0) result_rate = 100 # Štátny poistenec (student on DoBPŠ / working pensioner) pays no health # insurance on agreement income (z. 580/2004). if contract.l10n_sk_health_exempt: result = 0.0

min_base = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_min_base') if contract.l10n_sk_ztp: rate_ee = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee_ztp') rate_er = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employer_ztp') else: rate_ee = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employee') rate_er = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_health_rate_employer') min_combined = min_base * (rate_ee + rate_er) / 100.0 actual_combined = abs(result_rules.HEALTH.total) + result_rules.HEALTHEMPLOYER.total result = -max(0.0, min_combined - actual_combined) if contract.l10n_sk_health_exempt: result = 0.0

base = result_rules.TAXBASE.total
# --- NČZD (non-taxable part per taxpayer) --- nczd = 0.0 if contract.l10n_sk_tax_declaration_signed: # SK §35: monthly advances apply the FULL monthly NČZD; the §11 ods.2 # high-income taper is settled only in the annual reconciliation. nczd = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_nczd_monthly')
taxable = max(0.0, base - nczd)
# --- Progressive monthly bands --- bands = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_income_tax_bands') tax = 0.0 prev = 0.0 for rate, ceiling in bands: if taxable > prev: amt = min(taxable, ceiling) - prev tax += amt * rate prev = ceiling
result = -tax

n_young = contract.l10n_sk_children_under_15 n_teen = contract.l10n_sk_children_15_18 n = n_young + n_teen
if n <= 0 or not contract.l10n_sk_tax_declaration_signed: result = 0.0 else: amount = (n_young * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_child_bonus_under_15') + n_teen * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_child_bonus_15_18'))
# Cap at %-of-(partial)-tax-base by number of children (1..6+). caps = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_child_bonus_pct_caps') cap_pct = caps[min(n, len(caps)) - 1] base = result_rules.TAXBASE.total amount = min(amount, base * cap_pct / 100.0)
# High-income taper (annual base above threshold). threshold = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_child_bonus_taper_threshold') threshold_m = threshold / 12.0 if base > threshold_m: coeff = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_child_bonus_taper_coeff') amount -= coeff * (base - threshold_m)
result = max(0.0, amount)

mtype = contract.l10n_sk_meal_allowance_type if mtype == 'none': result = 0.0 result_qty = 0.0 else: days = contract.l10n_sk_meal_days if not days: days = worked_days.WORK100.number_of_days if 'WORK100' in worked_days.dict else 0.0 if contract.l10n_sk_meal_voucher_employer: per_day = contract.l10n_sk_meal_voucher_employer else: stravne = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_stravne_5_12h') _exact = stravne * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_meal_employer_pct') / 100.0 # § 152 sets a MINIMUM the employer must contribute, and 55 % of the # 2026 stravné is exactly 5.115 — a third decimal a payslip line # cannot hold. The two engines then disagreed: the OCA engine derives # the line total from the 2-decimal amount (20 x 5.12 = 102.40) while # Enterprise derives it from the unrounded value (102.30). Round UP to # the cent, as the surcharge kernel does for statutory floors: it is # the only direction that cannot fall below the minimum, and it leaves # the two engines with the same number to work from. _cents = round(_exact, 6) * 100.0 _whole = int(_cents) per_day = (_whole + (1 if _cents - _whole > 0.000001 else 0)) / 100.0 # total = result_qty * rate(100) * result / 100 = days * per_day result_qty = days result = per_day

# Only the meal-voucher option leaves an employee share (voucher value less the # employer contribution). The financial contribution has no employee share. mtype = contract.l10n_sk_meal_allowance_type if mtype != 'voucher': result = 0.0 result_qty = 0.0 else: days = contract.l10n_sk_meal_days if not days: days = worked_days.WORK100.number_of_days if 'WORK100' in worked_days.dict else 0.0 if contract.l10n_sk_meal_voucher_employee: per_day = contract.l10n_sk_meal_voucher_employee else: stravne = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_stravne_5_12h') voucher_value = round(stravne * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_meal_voucher_min_pct') / 100.0, 4) employer_day = round(stravne * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_meal_employer_pct') / 100.0, 4) per_day = max(0.0, voucher_value - employer_day) # total = result_qty * rate(100) * result / 100 = days * (-per_day) result_qty = days result = -per_day
result = ('GARNISHMENT' in inputs.dict or 'GARNISHMENT_PRIORITY' in inputs.dict or ('hr.wage.garnishment' in payslip.env and payslip.env['hr.wage.garnishment']._payslip_has_orders(payslip)))

# Net wage (čistá mzda) = gross − employee social − employee health − tax, plus # the child bonus. categories.SOCIALEMPLOYEE (negative) already holds both the # social and health employee premiums. net_wage = (result_rules.GROSS.total + categories.SOCIALEMPLOYEE + result_rules.INCOMETAX.total + result_rules.CHILD_BONUS.total)
# Prefer the garnishment register, but ONLY for employees who actually # have an order on file. Installing the register must not silently # disable the input-driven path for everyone else — a site can migrate # employee by employee. Where both exist, the register wins. _has_register = ('hr.wage.garnishment' in payslip.env and payslip.env['hr.wage.garnishment']._payslip_has_orders(payslip)) if _has_register: # Full multi-claim waterfall across all active orders. result = -payslip.env['hr.wage.garnishment']._payslip_amount(payslip, net_wage) elif 'GARNISHMENT' in inputs.dict or 'GARNISHMENT_PRIORITY' in inputs.dict: # Legacy single-claim fallback (see the comment above the record). zm = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_zivotne_minimum') if 'GARNISHMENT_PRIORITY' in inputs.dict: debt = inputs.GARNISHMENT_PRIORITY.amount thirds = 2 # § 2 ods. 2 — a priority creditor reaches deeper: the base that must # be left to the debtor is 100 % ŽM, NOT the ordinary 140 %. coeff = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_garnishment_priority_coeff') else: debt = inputs.GARNISHMENT.amount thirds = 1 coeff = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_garnishment_basic_coeff') basic = round(zm * coeff, 2) per_dep = round(basic * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_garnishment_dependent_coeff'), 2) non_seizable = basic + contract.l10n_sk_garnishment_dependents * per_dep
remainder = net_wage - non_seizable if remainder <= 0: result = 0.0 else: # § 3 — the unlimited-seizure threshold always keys off the § 1 ods. 1 # basic sum, whichever kind of claim is being collected. ordinary_basic = round(zm * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_garnishment_basic_coeff'), 2) unlimited_threshold = ordinary_basic * payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_garnishment_unlimited_mult') over = max(0.0, remainder - unlimited_threshold) base = remainder - over # min(remainder, unlimited_threshold) # Round the base DOWN to a sum divisible by three (in eurocents). base_cents = int(round(base * 100)) base_cents -= base_cents % 3 one_third = base_cents / 3.0 / 100.0 seizable = thirds * one_third + over result = -min(debt, seizable) else: result = 0.0
result = ('PN' in worked_days.dict or 'PN_DAYS' in inputs.dict) and 'PN_DVZ' in inputs.dict

# Sick days are driven from the PN leave (worked_days.PN); the manual PN_DAYS # input is the fallback when no leave is recorded. The denný vymeriavací základ # (DVZ) is a separate statutory base (not priemerný zárobok), still taken from # the PN_DVZ input. SIMPLIFICATION: náhrada príjmu is paid per CALENDAR day for # the first 10/14 days; the leave gives WORKING days, used here as a proxy. if 'PN' in worked_days.dict: days = abs(worked_days.dict['PN'].number_of_days) else: days = inputs.PN_DAYS.amount dvz = min(inputs.PN_DVZ.amount, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_pn_max_dvz')) tier1_days = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_pn_tier1_days') employer_days = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_pn_employer_days') rate1 = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_pn_rate_tier1') / 100.0 rate2 = payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_pn_rate_tier2') / 100.0 paid = min(days, employer_days) d1 = min(paid, tier1_days) d2 = max(0.0, paid - tier1_days) result = round(dvz * (d1 * rate1 + d2 * rate2), 2)

# The OOP reduces the base for old-age (starobné), disability (invalidné) and # the solidarity reserve fund by up to the OOP amount, but never accident or # guarantee insurance. Only one such agreement per month may claim it. base = min(categories.GROSS, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_monthly_taxable_max')) result = min(base, payslip.rule_parameter('l10n_sk_dohoda_oop'))

# categories.DED already nets the employee social+health (SOCIALEMPLOYEE), # income tax (INCOMETAX) and the raw statutory deductions. The child bonus and # the financial meal contribution are added explicitly (both exempt from GROSS). meal_net = result_rules.MEALEMPLOYEE.total # employee voucher share (negative or 0) if contract.l10n_sk_meal_allowance_type == 'financial': meal_net += result_rules.MEALEMPLOYER.total # cash paid with the wage result = ( BASIC + categories.ALW + categories.DED + result_rules.CHILD_BONUS.total + meal_net )
result = any(_c in worked_days.dict for _c in ( 'PREKAZKA_PRESTOJ', 'PREKAZKA_POCASIE', 'PREKAZKA_INE', 'PREKAZKA_VAZNE'))

_rates = ( ('PREKAZKA_PRESTOJ', 'l10n_sk_prekazka_prestoj_pct'), ('PREKAZKA_POCASIE', 'l10n_sk_prekazka_pocasie_pct'), ('PREKAZKA_INE', 'l10n_sk_prekazka_ine_pct'), ('PREKAZKA_VAZNE', 'l10n_sk_prekazka_vazne_pct'), ) _avg = payslip.l10n_sk_average_hourly_earnings() _total = 0.0 for _code, _param in _rates: if _code in worked_days.dict: _hours = abs(worked_days.dict[_code].number_of_hours) _total += _hours * _avg * payslip.rule_parameter(_param) / 100.0 result = round(_total, 2)
